The '''Gateworlds''' was a quadrant near the middle of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] and was small in size.<ref name="TEA" /> In total, the quadrant contained a complete amount of four inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and was intersected by only one [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]].
